# zip-password-finder

zip-password-finder is a tool to find the password of protected ZIP files.

Features
- Supports both ZipCrypto and AES-encrypted ZIP archives.
- Dictionary attack (test passwords from a dictionary file, one word per line).
- Brute-force attack with configurable character sets and password length range.
- Multi-threaded workers to speed up the search.

Character sets available for brute force generation:

  l | abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz [a-z]
  u | ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ [A-Z]
  d | 0123456789                 [0-9]
  h | 0123456789abcdef           [0-9a-f]
  H | 0123456789ABCDEF           [0-9A-F]
  s | "space" and symbols

  zip-password-finder --inputFile secret.zip --passwordDictionary words.txt
